```lean
theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {f g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i := by
  let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := Id
  let hσ : σ = Id := rfl
  let h1 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f (σ i) * g i := Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg
  let h2 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f i * g (σ i) := Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg
  let h3 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i :=
    calc
      ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i
      := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm] at h1
        exact h1.trans h2
```
